title: Mixed Engression: Distributional Regression for Multivariate Mixed-Type Responses
abstract: arXiv:2610.32850v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Estimating the conditional distribution of multivariate responses with continuous and binary components requires capturing their dependence, respecting their different supports, and accommodating potentially heavy-tailed continuous outcomes. We propose mixed engression, which fits a continuous generator using energy losses induced by bounded discrepancies and then thresholds its soft binary outputs to produce mixed-response samples. Because the discrepancies are bounded, the population objective remains well defined without response-moment assumptions. However, we show that the full-response energy distance for the complete response vector can tend to zero before thresholding yet remain bounded away from zero afterward as response dimensions grow. translated_title: 混合Engression：面向多变量混合类型响应的分布回归
translated_abstract: 估计同时包含连续分量和二元分量的多变量响应的条件分布，需要捕捉它们之间的依赖关系、尊重它们不同的支撑集，并适应可能具有重尾特征的连续结果。我们提出了混合engression（mixed engression）方法：首先使用由有界差异诱导的能量损失拟合一个连续生成器，然后对其软二元输出进行阈值化处理，从而产生混合响应样本。由于差异是有界的，即使不对响应矩做任何假设，总体目标函数仍然保持良定义。然而，我们证明了完整响应向量的全响应能量距离可能在阈值化之前趋于零，但随着响应维度的增长，阈值化之后仍可能有界地远离零。因此，对整个二元向量施加一个单独的能量损失，可以捕捉被全响应比较所掩盖的差异，并控制阈值化的影响。生成器因此通过……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出混合engression方法，利用有界差异诱导的能量损失拟合连续生成器并对软二元输出进行阈值化，从而在无需响应矩假设的条件下估计多变量混合类型（连续与二元）响应的条件分布。
en_tdlr: Proposes mixed engression, which fits a continuous generator via energy losses induced by bounded discrepancies and thresholds its soft binary outputs, enabling distributional regression for multivariate mixed-type responses without response-moment assumptions.
